mapper.select: SELECT DATE(s.sale_date) AS date, SUM(s.total_price) AS totalAmount FROM sales s WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(s.sale_date) ORDER BY date

SELECT m.name AS medicineName, SUM(sd.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(sd.quantity * sd.price) AS totalAmount FROM sale_detail sd JOIN medicine m ON sd.medicine_id = m.medicine_id JOIN sales s ON sd.sale_id = s.sale_id WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
